note: One entry per scope and site. 'archive_root' is its folder on the archive drive. 'match' says how a frame in the ledger is recognised as this scope: by camera name, and for the two Askars (one camera, one archive folder) by the scope name the import worked out from the focal length. Colours follow the Observatory palette; null means Brett hasn't picked one yet. 'aliases' are other spellings a filename or folder may use for the scope ('30P', 'S30Pro'). match.camera must equal the ledger's camera name exactly. A scope's id, name and aliases are also how a filename names it, so no two scopes may share one. Leave 'unit' in place on the two site entries: it is what keeps them switched off.

Until it does, their frames count under the Shinfield entry, and the two entries above stay switched off ('unit': null). Leave them as they are.
